text: Setting project goals is essential for success. One effective way is to use SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. These goals help your team stay focused and know exactly what to achieve. It is also important to set milestones, which are key points that show your progress along the way. Deliverables are the final products or results you must complete, such as a report or a website. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the beginning. When everyone is aligned, the project runs more smoothly and has a better chance of success.
